paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Peridah: his teacher Rabbi Eliezer went to him at Uvlin, and Rabbi Eliezer called him ‘my son’: Eruvin 11b, end, continuing on 12a, and Tosefta there. This requires examination; see above, Rabbi Yose ben Yose.
